title: HD player body: Troll male (model, textures, faces, hair, skin colors)
description: Replaces the Troll male player model (display 1478) with a community HD body via private CreatureModelData row 2380, plus CharSections rows for every skin/face/hair/facial-hair/underwear variation. Built by tools/characters/build_characters.py into mod-source/characters-hd (shared patch-0 payload with the other 15 bodies).
unavailable_reason: Not reproducible from an owned WoW install: model and textures come from the community VanillaHD/Patch-A repository (commit dcf3647e80104d03c02e1540c61cce3ca7e24766), source M2 Character/Troll/Male/TrollMale.m2 sha256 8c4fd889ec59faeb84be1417b66eb77a04388fcab0eeead4926660ac6cca24ab. A Retail-derived replacement needs the asset-coverage worker's character-model conversion (retail M2 -> 1.12 format, 5 geoset families, CharSections remap) which is not built yet.
